The compact chibi preserves Zelo's conditioned athletic build through moderate shoulders, a trim functional torso, and proportionate leg mass without ripped definition or generic body-fat inflation.
Upper arms, forearms, wrists, and open empty hands remain balanced against the source and are not inflated into oversized fists or bulky forearms.
Brown-chestnut medium-loose hair retains the side part, asymmetric front sweep, gathered mass, and wrapped side section from the verified summon.

The plum-gray short mantle, unarmored tunic, divided lower layers, offset closures, reinforced cuffs, visible prideful mending, pouch, and contrasting boot laces remain source-consistent, with no earring, tattoo, or new decorative anchor.

The planted asymmetrical stance, separated limbs, open empty hands, broad mantle silhouette, and strong palette blocks remain legible as a weaponless ready-idle at icon scale.
